preconditions.description: Number of test cases T is between 1 and 10^4.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 10**5 for N in Ns)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the size of arrays A and B (N) is between 1 and 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(-10**14 <= Ai <= 10**14 for Ai in As)
preconditions.description: Each element in array A is between -10^14 and 10^14.

preconditions.expression: all(-10**14 <= Bi <= 10**14 for Bi in Bs)
preconditions.description: Each element in array B is between -10^14 and 10^14.
The sum of N over all test cases does not exceed 2 * 10^5.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(result, int) for result in results)
all(result == -1 or result >= 0 for result in results)
postconditions.description: Each result is either -1 (impossible) or a non-negative integer (number of operations).

postconditions.expression: all(result == -1 if any(Ai > Bi for Ai, Bi in zip(A, B)) else True for A, B, result in zip(As, Bs, results))
postconditions.description: If any element in A is greater than the corresponding element in B, the result is -1.

postconditions.expression: all(result == sum(max(Bi - Ai, 0) for Ai, Bi in zip(A, B)) for A, B, result in zip(As, Bs, results))
postconditions.description: The result is the sum of the maximum differences between corresponding elements in A and B.
